prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: a block of cheddar grated in a fast orange blizzard, shreds piling into a mountain in macro. The camera slides to butter and flour whisked into a blond paste, milk poured in a spiral, thickening visibly as the whisk trails hold. Money shot: the cheese mountain pushed into the white sauce and folded until it collapses into a glossy orange river, then cooked elbow pasta poured in and turned — a spoon lifting a mass that stretches in thick pulls back into the pot, steam backlit. Final beat: a scoop into a bowl, the stretch breaking and folding on top. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the grating rasp, then the thick fold. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
